verdict.rationale: Cactus documents its own hybrid cloud fallback: the engine can "route hard queries to the cloud automatically based on local model confidence." That is a product-side way to send inference to a hosted tier. However, routing is triggered by confidence, not by insufficient local hardware, and the hosted GPUs in the pricing docs are for training, not inference. Missing for 10: documented hosted inference of very large models, explicit no-download cloud-only model use, hardware-based offload triggers, details on which cloud models or tiers serve routed queries, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient

citations.quote: Route hard queries to the cloud automatically based on local model confidence
